description: An annual KT Canada training institute run by KT Canada that combines didactic and active learning, small-group project work, mentor exposure, and facilitated poster presentations for graduate trainees and postdoctoral fellows.
title: KT Canada Summer Institute

description: A KT Canada framework organizing knowledge-translation capacity building into three training streams for graduate trainees, researchers, and knowledge users, delivered through participating universities with courses, seminars, mentorship, and related training activities.
title: KT Canada three-stream national training framework for knowledge translation capacity building

description: KT4EQG is a personalized question-generation system combining knowledge tracing, large-language-model generation, reinforcement learning, and an alignment verifier, developed by Xinyi Gao et al.
title: KT4EQG

description: An open-source code repository released by Kai Neubauer and colleagues implementing knowledge tracing set transformers, their set-based interaction embeddings, and learnable ALiBi attention for research in knowledge tracing and intelligent tutoring systems.
title: KTST
